nodes.name: config.json
nodes.summary: Analysis tool setting fixing the generated graph language to English.

nodes.name: eslint.config.mjs
nodes.summary: Root ESLint flat config combining recommended, type-checked TypeScript, and Prettier rules with Node and Jest globals.

nodes.name: eslint.config.mjs
nodes.summary: Frontend ESLint flat config extending the Next.js core-web-vitals and TypeScript presets with build-output ignores.

nodes.name: next.config.ts
nodes.summary: Next.js configuration pointing the Turbopack root at the monorepo root above the frontend directory.

nodes.name: postcss.config.mjs
nodes.summary: PostCSS configuration registering only the Tailwind CSS v4 plugin, with no separate Tailwind config file.

nodes.name: en.json
nodes.summary: English UI strings for navigation, home, products, cart, orders, login, register, admin, and language switcher sections.

nodes.name: fr.json
nodes.summary: French UI strings mirroring the English dictionary across navigation, products, cart, orders, auth, and admin sections.

nodes.name: globals.css
nodes.summary: Dark glassmorphism storefront stylesheet defining theme variables, glass panels, buttons, inputs, badges, and a fade-in animation.
nodes.languageNotes: Tailwind CSS v4 entry via @import "tailwindcss" plus custom CSS variables and component classes.

nodes.name: proxy.ts
nodes.summary: Locale-aware request proxy that lets locale-prefixed paths through and redirects all other paths to their /en or /fr equivalent.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the Next.js proxy convention (exported proxy function plus matcher config) instead of a middleware.ts file.

nodes.name: .graphify_labels.json.sig
nodes.summary: Signature artifact of a previous graph scan with no project source content.

nodes.name: .graphify_root
nodes.summary: Root marker artifact of a previous graph scan with no project source content.

nodes.name: stat-index.json
nodes.summary: Generated file-statistics cache from a previous graph scan, kept for context only.

nodes.name: collection.json
nodes.summary: Postman request collection for the NestJS API covering auth, users, products, and orders, parameterized with base_url and token variables.

nodes.name: environment.json
nodes.summary: Postman environment defining the base_url variable pointing at localhost:3002 plus empty token and api_key variables.

nodes.name: prisma.config.ts
nodes.summary: Prisma CLI configuration wiring the schema path, the migrations directory, and the DATABASE_URL datasource.

nodes.name: migration_lock.toml
nodes.summary: Prisma migration provider lock pinning the migrations to postgresql.

nodes.name: schema.prisma
nodes.summary: Prisma Postgres schema defining the Role enum and the User, Cart, CartItem, Product, Order, and OrderItem models with their relations.
nodes.languageNotes: Postgres datasource with one-to-one User-Cart, unique cart/product pairs, and cascade delete from Cart to CartItem.

nodes.name: user.entity.ts
nodes.summary: Placeholder User entity class with no fields or methods yet.

nodes.name: test-data.ts
nodes.summary: Shared test fixtures for a regular user, an admin, two products, and invalid-input edge cases.

nodes.name: auth.helper.ts
nodes.summary: Supertest helpers that register users, log in for JWT tokens, and combine both steps for API test setup.

nodes.name: jest-e2e.json
nodes.summary: Jest configuration running end-to-end, security, and edge-case specs through ts-jest.

nodes.name: jest-integration.json
nodes.summary: Jest configuration running integration-spec suites through ts-jest.

nodes.name: User
nodes.summary: Initial migration creating the User account table with unique email, optional name, password, and USER/ADMIN role.
nodes.languageNotes: Postgres SERIAL primary key with a Role enum defaulting to USER.

nodes.name: Product
nodes.summary: Initial migration creating the Product catalog table with name, float price, and integer stock.

nodes.name: Order
nodes.summary: Orders migration creating the Order header table linking each purchase to its buyer and creation timestamp.
nodes.languageNotes: Foreign key to User with restricted deletes and cascading updates.

nodes.name: OrderItem
nodes.summary: Orders migration creating the OrderItem line-item table linking orders to products with quantities.

nodes.name: Cart
nodes.summary: Cart migration creating the one-per-user Cart header table with a unique user reference.

nodes.name: CartItem
nodes.summary: Cart migration creating the CartItem line-item table with cascade delete from its parent cart.
nodes.languageNotes: Cascade delete on cart removal with restricted deletes toward products.

nodes.name: getLocale
nodes.summary: Resolves the request locale from the NEXT_LOCALE cookie first, then the Accept-Language header, defaulting to French.

nodes.name: proxy
nodes.summary: Passes locale-prefixed requests through and redirects locale-less paths to their localized URL with query preserved.

nodes.name: User
nodes.summary: Empty exported User entity stub reserved for future user shape and behavior.

nodes.name: registerUser
nodes.summary: Registers a user through POST /auth/register in API tests and returns the status and body.

nodes.name: loginUser
nodes.summary: Logs in through POST /auth/login in API tests and returns the JWT access token.

nodes.name: registerAndLogin
nodes.summary: Registers a user and immediately logs in to yield a ready-to-use token for API tests.
